title: hieracium lamprophyllum subsp. cantabricum
intro: Hieracium lamprophyllum subsp. cantabricum, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is native to the Cantabrian Mountains in northern Spain. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium lamprophyllum subsp. cantabricum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
